title: Grade 6 Science — Wed, Jun 03
description: Fibre to Fabric — Day 3 of 5: Weaving and knitting
subject: science

questions.question: The process of arranging two sets of yarn together to make a fabric is called:
questions.explanation: Weaving is the process of interlacing two sets of yarn to make fabric.

questions.question: The device used to weave yarn into fabric is called a:
questions.explanation: A loom is the device on which yarn is woven into fabric.

questions.question: Making a fabric from a single yarn by forming loops is called:
questions.explanation: Knitting uses a single yarn to make a fabric by forming interconnected loops.

questions.question: A sweater is usually made by:
questions.explanation: Sweaters and socks are commonly made by knitting yarn.

questions.question: Weaving uses how many sets of yarn?
questions.explanation: Weaving interlaces two sets of yarn crossing each other.

questions.question: A loom operated by hand is called a:
questions.explanation: A handloom is a loom worked by hand, while a power loom runs on electricity.

questions.question: Knitting can be done by hand using:
questions.explanation: Hand knitting is done using knitting needles to form loops of yarn.

questions.question: Looms run by electricity that weave cloth quickly are called:
questions.explanation: Power looms use electricity to weave large amounts of cloth quickly.

questions.question: Which item is usually woven, not knitted?
questions.explanation: A cotton bedsheet is woven on a loom, while sweaters, socks and caps are knitted.

questions.question: If a single yarn comes loose, a knitted fabric may:
questions.explanation: Because knitting uses loops of one yarn, pulling a loose end can make it unravel.

questions.question: The correct overall order from fibre to cloth is:
questions.explanation: Fibres are spun into yarn, and yarn is woven (or knitted) into fabric.

questions.question: Weaving is an old craft in India. Weavers who make cloth are skilled workers called:
questions.explanation: People skilled in weaving cloth on looms are called weavers.

questions.question: Why are two yarns needed in weaving but only one in knitting?
options: Weaving crosses two sets; knitting loops a single yarn
They both use the same number
questions.explanation: Weaving interlaces two sets of yarn, while knitting forms loops from a single yarn.

questions.question: Which is a benefit of power looms over handlooms?
options: They produce cloth faster and in large amounts
questions.explanation: Power looms weave cloth much faster and in larger quantities than handlooms.

questions.question: After fabric is made, it is usually ____ before being sold as clothes.
questions.explanation: Fabric is dyed or printed for colour and then stitched into clothes.
